Do not let this game take over your life and teenage years like it did to me. Play it, but play in moderation. Understand that no matter how good you are, or how good you get, there is someone more lifeless and toxic than you. Do not invest "i want to go pro" amount of hours into this game because it is has THE hardest skill ceiling in fighting game history. Yes you heard me correctly. No i am not delusional. Even if you become a pro, the earnings has decreased evey year and it is just not the investment it used to be. Imagine fighting prime Jon Jones for 100 dollars. If you are reading this please do anything but sink large amounts of hours into this game, this is not even a review im genuinely begging you. Do not make my mistake.  The best player to ever come from Brawlhalla is Sandstorm, and no matter how good you get, nobody will ever match up to his level, I dont care how many tournaments they win. so please give it up. Let this game die or wait for Brawlhalla 2 or something.

Amazing at making you rage, that is. Nonetheless it's actually a pretty fun game, provided you never step foot into ranked, or even worse, unranked. Just stick to playing with your friends, because the game has plenty of fun modes to offer and is perfect for messing around and having a good time. That said, i strongly advise against taking this game competitively. They people who reside in ranked are not human. They are demons.
